sections.h2: Plymouth Park Home Prices and Market Pace
sections.html:
In the 24 months from November 15, 2024 to November 14, 2026, 113 residential sales closed in Plymouth Park (Chesapeake, VA) according to REIN MLS records. The median sold price was $285,000, below the citywide median of $420,000, and homes took a median of 17 days to sell, about the same pace as the citywide median of 18 days. These figures come from closed sales, which show what homes actually sold for rather than asking prices.

The middle half of Plymouth Park sales closed between $235,000 and $310,000, or about $241 per square foot against $219 citywide. Split by year, the median sold price in the most recent 12 months ($285,000, 53 sales) was about 4% higher than in the earlier 12 months ($274,500, 60 sales). The typical home sold right at its list price (median sale-to-list ratio of 100%).

sections.h2: What Kinds of Homes Sell in Plymouth Park
sections.html:
All of the sales were detached single-family homes. The median home was about 1,024 square feet, with the middle half of sales running from roughly 950 to 1,327 square feet. 80% of the homes that sold had 3 bedrooms.

Home ages vary widely here: about 80% of sales were built between 1955 and 2012, with a median year built of 1958.

Averages hide a lot, so Chris Jenkins compares you to homes that match yours on street, size, age and condition rather than to the whole Plymouth Park median.
